hooks.name: Guard dependencies
hooks.description: Block edits to package.json and ask Brandon to review them against docs/speed.yml.

action.command: node -e " const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs'); const { posix } = require('node:path'); const event = JSON.parse(readFileSync(0, 'utf8')); const input = event.tool_input ?? event.toolInput; const target = input?.path ?? input?.file_path ?? input?.filePath; if (typeof target === 'string') { const path = posix.normalize(target.replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(92), '/')); if (posix.basename(path).toLowerCase() === 'package.json') { console.error('BLOCKED: Ask Brandon before editing package.json. Check dependency proposals against approved_packages in docs/speed.yml.'); process.exitCode = 2; } } "
